show.title: Andha Cricketer
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/HDAhc3
show.description: This microdrama follows Victor Sethi, a star cricketer who is brutally blinded by his rival, Dushyant, only to resurface years later as a humble, blind sweeper named Vaibhav. When a struggling academy owned by Riya faces a hostile takeover, Victor is forced to reveal his superhuman "sound-based" batting skills to save her legacy. Amidst intense match-fixing and physical threats, he overcomes a rigged final match using a wooden staff to defeat Dushyant once and for all.
